about.title: About Built Right Construction
about.text: Established in 1996, Built Right Construction is locally owned and operated by Mark Crawford, a licensed remodeling contractor and Certified EPA Lead-Safe Renovator with more than 20 years of experience in building, design, and construction. We are fully licensed, bonded, and insured, with references and proof of insurance and license available on request, so you can be assured your project will be built right the first time. We offer free estimates with no obligation.

reviews.author: Gina McCarty
reviews.text: Built Right Construction restored my faith that honesty and integrity still exist when hiring someone to do quality work. Our kitchen was gutted and remodeled to perfection. Mark goes above and beyond what one would expect. His knowledge and skill in his industry helped us design a more efficient kitchen and office space for our home. He also added a beautiful roof and lighting over our patio.

reviews.author: Evella Bowers Richardson
reviews.text: Mark and his team did an excellent job on replacement of our 2nd story deck. He is very knowledgeable in his field of work and I would recommend him to the president. Love them and their work.
